[b]12/08/19 UPDATE:[/b]
Unfortunately I will not be supporting this mod anymore meaning there will be no future updates. It should still be compatible with the 1.3 update, however I have not play tested it and cannot guarantee this. If you wish to update it or modify it yourself you are welcome to do so, posting it is fine as long as credit is given :-)

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

These buildings are inspired by what farms look like where I live and the farm I grew up on :>

[u][b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:
[/b][/u]
- Backup your original buildings folder first if you wish
- unzip the downloaded file with a program like winzip
- place all of the xnb files in Content\Buildings
- done!
